newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chinese dies after being hurled from Moscow window.
newsitem.headline: Chinese dies after being hurled from Moscow window.

text.p: A Chinese man died after being hurled through the window of a Moscow hostel during a row about money, police said on Thursday.
Three men had demanded cash for a purchase the Chinese had made and when he failed to pay them stabbed him in the chest and then threw him through the window, a police spokeswoman said.
The attackers also seriously wounded a male companion of the Chinese man by shooting him in the head and handcuffed a woman also in the hostel room to a radiator, she said.
A Chinese woman suspected of involvement in the incident has been detained by police, the spokeswoman added.

Russia has seen an upsurge in violent crime since the collapse of Soviet communism in 1991. Chinese traders have become quite common in larger Russian cities and in the country's Far East region as private enterprise has boomed.
